notes.title: Retirement Notice
notes.notes: [p]This game will soon be retired from sale on Steam.  [/p][p]Existing owners will still be able to download and play it without any issues.  [/p][p]IMPORTANT UPDATE: The game will be re-released in the future with updated graphics and some new features that make gameplay easier.  [/p][p]However, please note that the Math, Word, and Classic modes will unfortunately not be included in the new version.  [/p][p]Please make your decision accordingly — whether to purchase this version now or wait for the upcoming release.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support.[/p][p][/p][p]For future updates and announcements, please join our community on Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/gkFjsM9bRU"]https://discord.gg/gkFjsM9bRU[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
